metadata.description: Marketplace hosting the jidoka dev-workflow plugin for Claude Code and its Copilot CLI render, jidoka-copilot, both generated from one source tree (the Cursor render, jidoka-cursor, is listed in .cursor-plugin/marketplace.json). They run the same 10-phase orchestrator-driven flow - plan-then-build with vertical-slice architecture, slice-by-slice implementation, and an end-to-end test-plan walkthrough with screenshots embedded into the PR body. Also hosts standalone skill plugins: utility-skills, code-to-prd, and clinical-lecture-brief.

plugins.name: jidoka
plugins.description: Claude Code dev-workflow plugin. The `line` skill drives the 10-phase plan-then-build flow in the main session, dispatching helper subagents (code-explorer, code-architect, plan-reviewer, impl-backend, impl-frontend, impl-simplify, code-reviewer, security-reviewer, test-plan-walker) as needed. Loop position persists in a per-slice 07-progress.md ledger so the workflow is resumable.

plugins.name: jidoka-copilot
plugins.description: Copilot CLI render of jidoka, generated from the same source: the `line` skill drives the 10-phase plan-then-build flow, dispatching the same nine subagents in Copilot's .agent.md format with Copilot tool aliases and model ids, and the after-edit hooks ship as a postToolUse set.

plugins.name: utility-skills
plugins.description: Collection of standalone utility skills — teach-me and more.

plugins.name: code-to-prd
plugins.description: Reverse-engineer any codebase into a complete Product Requirements Document (PRD). Analyzes routes, components, models, APIs, and interactions for frontend (React, Vue, Angular, Next.js), backend (NestJS, Django, Express, FastAPI), .NET/ASP.NET (Web API, WCF, Web Forms), native mobile (Android, iOS), and fullstack applications.

plugins.name: clinical-lecture-brief
plugins.description: Turn a clinical or medical YouTube lecture into a published, audience-calibrated teaching artifact. Fetches the transcript, repairs speech-recognition garbling, verifies the medicine against current teaching, and builds a designed HTML study reference.
